keywords: 灵活 nonce 与签名者绑定
EIP-7708 借助 EIP-8246 简化
summary: 周日。pedrouid 提交 EIP-8141 扩展，加入 guarantor、灵活 nonce 和签名者绑定，guarantor 让发送方 VERIFY frame 无法安全模拟的交易也能进入公共内存池。EIP-7708 依赖 EIP-8246 去掉 ETH 销毁日志的边缘情况并合并。

items.title: EIP-8141：加入 guarantor、灵活 nonce 与签名者绑定
items.note: （pedrouid）提交。guarantor 是一个付款方原语，发送方的 `VERIFY` frame 无法安全模拟时，仍可让交易进入公共内存池，原样采纳 PR #11555 的 `APPROVE_GUARANTEE = 0x4` 范围和规范的 paymaster guarantor 模式。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: extend with guarantors, flexible nonces and signer binding
items.note_en: (pedrouid), submitted. A guarantor is a payer primitive that admits a transaction to the public mempool even when the sender's `VERIFY` frame is unsafe to simulate; it adopts PR #11555's `APPROVE_GUARANTEE = 0x4` scope and canonical paymaster guarantor mode verbatim.

items.title: EIP-7708：借助 EIP-8246 简化
items.note: （marioevz）合并，把 EIP-8246 设为依赖，彻底去掉 ETH 销毁日志的边缘情况。
items.note_en: (marioevz), merged, making EIP-8246 a dependency to remove the ETH burn log edge case completely.

summary_en: Sunday. pedrouid submitted an EIP-8141 extension with guarantors, flexible nonces and signer binding; guarantors let a transaction enter the public mempool even when the sender's VERIFY frame is unsafe to simulate. EIP-7708 took EIP-8246 as a dependency to remove the ETH burn log edge case, and it was merged.
